findings.title: Public administration rule
findings.name: legacy-admin
findings.evidence: TCP 22 from 0.0.0.0/0; TCP 3389 from ::/0. Rule configuration only; attachment and network reachability are not assessed.
findings.recommendation: Review dependencies. Prefer Systems Manager Session Manager, or restrict administration to approved source networks.

findings.title: Unassociated Elastic IP
findings.name: spare-address
findings.evidence: 192.0.2.10 has no association or network interface.
findings.recommendation: Check DNS, allowlists and disaster-recovery requirements before releasing it. Review actual billing; this is not a savings estimate.

findings.title: EBS encryption disabled
findings.name: legacy-data
findings.recommendation: Plan a tested migration using an encrypted snapshot copy and replacement volume. Existing volumes cannot be encrypted in place.

findings.title: Unattached EBS volume
findings.name: old-build-cache
findings.evidence: 80 GiB gp3 volume is available with no attachments.
findings.recommendation: Confirm the owner and retention needs. Snapshot if required, then approve deletion manually. Creation time is not detachment time.
